newsitem.title: FRANCE: France sells 3,000 T wheat to Iraq as food aid.
newsitem.headline: France sells 3,000 T wheat to Iraq as food aid.

text.p: France sold 3,000 tonnes of soft wheat to Iraq in a food aid tender it held on March 26, France's grain office ONIC said on Thursday.
France sold the wheat at 1,029.60 francs per tonne, Fob Caen, via the Rome-based World Food programme, it said.
France also sold 5,000 tonnes of maize to Haiti at 1,077 francs per tonne, Fob Port La Nouvelle, under another food aid tender held on March 26.
The wheat and the maize are for shipment between April 8 and April 30.
